character: weary female agama, sandy-orange hide, backwards cap, thick tail, fills two thirds of frame height
props: three fat toads with string bags - their place is her tail and body, never the ground, until 6.9; a 399 board beside the trail all clip, only digits on it; a motorcycle beside the trail all clip, black leather jacket and smoked-visor helmet on the handlebar, big suitcase on the rack; unmarked banknotes
motion_rule: the toads touch her every window until 6.9, never at a distance; every window she throws, wrenches, kicks or slams with her whole body - never a drag or plain walk; she drives at the lens until 6.9; new shot size every window
environment: dusty clay trail to the lens, hard midday sun and shadows; background under a third

audio.delivery: weary female voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: sbra-SY-va-yu, KHVOST, tya-zhe-LO, sbra-SY-va-ye-te, TSE-ny, ras-TUT
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: clay scraping, toad croaks, dry pop as the tail tears, engine roar, paper flutter

timeline.a: drives out of the depth at the lens, the bike beyond | three toads clustered on her tail, bags ploughing dust
drives her shoulder back into a toad on her spine | it slides off, grip never loosening
two rolling strides, she boots the middle toad with a hind foot | its bag snags a stone, jerking her hip
leans into the pull, claws cutting furrows | all three anchor back, one climbs her spine, shrugged off
throws her head into the lens, elbows the toad off her spine | it tears free, swinging, still on the tail
wrenches her hips, tears the cluster out of the rut, lunges on | all three swing out like a pendulum
rips the top toad off her back and slams it down at the lens | the other two whip out on the tail like a sling, bags smacking the 399 board, it rocks hard
one heave on both claws and the tail rips off at the base with a dry pop | all three ride the severed tail into the dust
freed, she springs up and rips the jacket and helmet off the handlebar | the three sprawl on the severed tail
shoulders into the jacket, jams the helmet on and snaps the smoked visor shut, stump twitching | one toad hops after and misses
swings a leg over and stamps the kick starter, rear wheel spinning up a wall of dust | it rolls over the three on the tail
the bike leaps into the depth past the 399 board, the suitcase lid springs open a crack, banknotes streaming out behind her
she shrinks into the dust far off | the three toads leap high snatching notes from the air and wrestle each other for them

must_appear: toad slammed at the lens at 5.2; tail rips off at 6.15-6.9; jacket on, visor shut by 8.2; banknotes fly at 8.8; the toads leap for them and fight at 9.4
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, any letters on the 399 board, static camera, same shot size twice, only her head moving, a gap between her and the toads before 6.9, a window where she only drags or walks, a wide shot at 5.2-6.15, a window where the toads do nothing, the severed tail gone from frame, anything held in her mouth, deformed anatomy, character changing mid-shot, English speech, any word after 6.9
